item.tib: gsas mkhar rab 'byams rtsa gsum kun 'dus las zlog pa'i 'ben tshogs rgyud bskul gyi mdal kha
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyigasama'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis/ chu byi lo hor zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gsum gyi srod 'khor la/ lho phyogs ngo mtshar gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo nas gter las spyan drangs te/ slad mar shing pho stag gi lo/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes la/ dbyibs klong lhun po brtsegs pa'i dgon du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o//
